test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A # B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is sister of B'.

If S # P % Q @ T & V % X, then how is S related to X?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 %
 &
 @
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Husband
 Brother
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: S # P % Q @ T & V % X

It means: S is the Daughter of P, P is the Husband of Q, Q is the Sister of T, T is the Brother of V, V is the Husband of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d1abb8ef6fae5286dd785e36b05b01e3488390b6268199a1f2a08c11b2fb676.png] 

So, S is the '**Husband’s sister’s daughter**' of X.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
